# Socials Assistant

> Open-source creator analytics vault + MCP server + agent skills. Official APIs only, permanent local history, draft-first outreach.

## What it does

Pulls a creator's OWN TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube analytics into a
local SQLite vault the platforms can't expire, then reads it: weekly digests,
top-content analysis, audience demographics, media kits, and brand-pitch drafts
backed by verified numbers. No scraping, no ToS risk — official APIs plus
TikTok Studio CSV imports for Studio-only data (retention, traffic sources).

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aryaminus/socials-assistant && cd socials-assistant
pnpm install && pnpm build          # or: ./setup.sh
node apps/mcp/bin/socials-mcp.js onboard
```

Then add the MCP server to any agent (config snippets in `agents/README.md`):
Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode, Cursor — locally via
stdio/HTTP, or deploy `infra/worker` to Cloudflare for a single remote URL.

## Key files

- `apps/mcp/` — socials-mcp server (15 tools, stdio + streamable HTTP) + CLI
- `packages/vault/` — SQLite vault, TikTok Studio CSV importer, analytics queries
- `packages/connectors/` — YouTube / Meta / TikTok official-API connectors
- `skills/` — socials-connect, weekly-digest, brand-outreach, media-kit
- `infra/worker/` — Cloudflare Workers remote MCP (OAuth 2.1, multi-tenant)
- `docs/` — per-platform onboarding, hosting, automation, deliverability

## Full docs

See `AGENTS.md` for all install methods, env vars, and operations.
See `README.md` for the project overview and capability map.
